title: Kanwaljeet Singh Batra v. Uttarakhand State Warehousing Corporation (WPMS/3816/2019)
summary: Saharanpur (UP) ka contractor. Warehousing Corporation ke e-tender mein shart thi ki 5 crore se kam ke tender mein sirf Uttarakhand ke registered contractor bolee de sakte hain, aur 5 crore se upar ke tender mein sab (clause 19, 21, para 3).
held: Rule 3(6) ki proviso sirf civil construction aur 5 crore tak ke kaam par lagti hai, aur doosre rajya walon ko bolee se nahi rokti (para 11–13). Employer financial capacity, experience aur past performance ki shartein laga sakta hai, par unka uddeshya se rishta hona chahiye. Yahan shartein "parochial considerations" se thi (para 16). Shartein quash (para 31).
use: Para 16 (Nagar Palika ke kaam ka): employer financial capacity, work experience aur past performance ki shartein laga sakta hai. Agar A/A+ category asal mein kshamta (capacity) par hai, domicile par nahi, to yahi tark.
caution: Shart ki banawat AMT ke case jaisi hai: 5 crore se kam local, upar sab ke liye. Yeh quash ho chuki hai.
Wahan Corporation ki taraf se Parikshit Saini ka 'employer free hai' wala tark khaarij hua (para 14, 16). Ab woh is group mein successful bidders ki taraf se hain.
